bundles.postBundles.description: Creates a bundle of up to 10 passes with one link.

bundles.deleteBundlesById.description: Deletes the bundle and revokes its link. The passes are kept.

bundles.postBundlesByIdSendEmail.description: Emails the bundle link. Send an `Idempotency-Key` to retry safely.

bundles.postBundlesByIdRotateLink.description: Replaces the bundle link. The old link stops working.
